name: Polaris Data Centre
developer: Springfield City Group / Polaris Data Centre
notes: Queensland's largest data centre at Springfield Central (Ipswich LGA); Springfield City Group says it developed Polaris at A$275m cost. Official pages describe carrier-neutral, N+2 high-availability design but do not publish MW capacity. Data Center Map also lists Polaris at Springfield Central.

name: Swanbank data centre proposal (Six Leaf Street / Blackheath Road)
notes: Ipswich Development.i application 12285/2026/MCU (05 Aug 2026): Material Change of Use - Warehouse (Data Centre), Lot 5 Six Leaf Street / Unnamed Road Swanbank. Related 9000/2026/SPSR (16 Jun 2026) is a superseded-planning-scheme request for MCU General Industry (Data Centre) at 99999 Blackheath Road; community reporting describes a proposed 10-storey (72m) 82,500 sqm data centre. Applications in assessment/confirmation stage; capacity MW not published.

name: Isaac Energy Hub data-centre co-location opportunity
notes: QPM Energy announced preliminary discussions with data-centre companies to co-locate at its Isaac Energy Hub / Isaac Power Station (up to 300MW gas) near Moranbah. Opportunity-only announcement, no datacentre load published. Risk flag: QPM Energy entered external administration 7 Jul 2026, putting the Isaac Power Station and any co-location plan in doubt.

name: Logan multifunctional edge data centre (MFEDC) program
developer: Logan City Council / Queensland Government / private partners (discussion)

name: Clarks Logan City Bus Service micro data centre
developer: Clarks Logan City Bus Service / BES IT Systems / Eaton
notes: Eaton case study: Clarks Logan City Buses deployed an Eaton Micro Data Centre to consolidate servers, switching and backup at its Logan bus depot. Enterprise micro-infrastructure, not a commercial colocation site.

name: Longreach Airport SmartCabinet mobile data centre
notes: Longreach Airport enclosed on-premises servers in a sealed climate-controlled Vertiv SmartCabinet (described as an enclosed mobile data centre) supporting CCTV, access control and corporate systems. Internal operational IT infrastructure; no commercial datacentre in Longreach. Re-verified 2026-08-12 (no new projects).

name: EC21 Mackay (Edge Centres)
notes: Baxtel lists EC21 Mackay at 35 River St, Mackay as an operational Edge Centres edge data centre; trade coverage describes Edge Centres' Queensland network acquired from DC Matrix. Public MW capacity not found. No new Mackay datacentre proposals found in 2026 searches.

name: Supernode Brendale hyperscale data centre campus
developer: Quinbrook Infrastructure Partners / Supernode Pty Ltd
notes: Quinbrook official page: Supernode is a 780 MW BESS + 230 MW-IT data centre campus across 30 ha at Brendale (Moreton Bay Council area), adjacent to South Pine substation (up to 800MW via three HV connections). Planning and FIRB approvals obtained; construction to date focused on BESS stages; Rest Super invested A$656m. capacity_mw=230 is official campus IT capacity, not yet operational DC load; site has potential for up to four hyperscale DCs.

name: PsiQuantum Moreton Bay Central utility-scale quantum computer facility
notes: PsiQuantum announced Moreton Bay Central (Petrie) as its Australian site (21 May 2026) and broke ground 17 Jun 2026 for the world's first utility-scale fault-tolerant quantum computer (US$940m government-backed). Specialised compute facility (photonic chips, cryogenics, optical-fibre cabinets) rather than conventional colocation DC; capacity MW not applicable.
